name: target_tractability_assessment
description: Multi-criteria target tractability scoring for small molecule and biologic drug discovery campaigns. Evaluates protein family, binding pocket geometry, literature evidence, and druggability to triage candidate targets before screening investment. Queries the AlphaFold structure database to confirm a structural model exists, but does NOT predict new structures — use AlphaFold or proteinfold workflows when structure prediction is the primary goal.
